lane: اه أَهَّ 1 , (S in art. اوه, and K,) inf. n. أَةٌّ (K) and أَهَّةٌ (S, * K) and the same without teshdeed; (K, * TA; [app. meaning آهَةٌ, which, however, belongs to art. اوه, q. v.;]) or إِهَّةٌ; (so in the CK; [but in some copies of the K, and ↓أَهَّهَ, as in the TK, where it is said that the inf. n. of this form of the verb is تَأْهِيهٌ;]) and ↓تأهّه; (K;) [i. q. آهَ and أَوَّهَ and تَأَهِيهٌ; or] He expressed pain or grief or sorrow, or he lamented or complained or moaned, (S, K,) as one in an evil state, and broken in spirit by grief or mourning, and said آهِ, or هَاهْ. (K.) [See a verse cited in art. اوه, voce آهَةٌ.] اهه اَهَّهَ 2 and 5: see above. إِهْ , i. e. إِ with the ه of pausation; imperative of وَأَي, q. v. (Mughnee in art. الف) آه آهِ and آهٍ and آهًا &c.: see art. اوه.
